description: Chest drops well forward at the bottom of every rep (about 62 deg).

assumptions.placement: one ESP32 + IMU flat on the upper back, between the shoulder blades
assumptions.imu_pitch_deg: forward lean of the upper torso from vertical, + = forward (hip hinge and rounding combined)
assumptions.imu_roll_deg: sideways tilt, + = toward the user's right
assumptions.accel_g: device frame: z up the spine, x out of the chest, y toward the user's left; 1 g at rest
assumptions.not_simulated: flex sensor, yaw, sensor calibration, real noise characteristics

times: device clock ms, the same clock as each message's timestamp_ms
